description: Find barbershops and salons ranked by weekly booth rent, with chairs available, Google rating, review count and hiring status. Answers what a chair costs in a given city and which shops have one free. Booth rent is quoted directly by shops rather than scraped, so coverage is partial — the response states how many listings actually publish a rate.

city.description: City to search, e.g. "Houston". Combine with state for accuracy.

open_chairs_only.description: Only listings with at least one chair currently available. Default false.

type.description: Barbershops, salons, or both. Default all.

verified_rent_only.description: Only listings that publish a booth rent figure. Default false.

name: compare_barbershops_salons
title: Compare barbershops & salons by booth rent and chair availability
